children.text: Grey = Roblox CoreGui (top bar 58px, chat window, leaderboard, mobile thumbstick + jump). Coloured = where our HUD lives. Every screen has a toggleable '[skip] Roblox CoreGui (guide)' layer on top; it is never exported. CoreGui draws ABOVE our UI, so close buttons must never sit under the leaderboard.
